question: Select all that apply: Which of these followed Operation Searchlight?

options.text: Armed resistance began, starting that night
Millions of civilians fled to India
A negotiated transfer of power to the Awami League

explanation: After the 25 March crackdown, resistance began that night, Mujib was arrested, and millions of people fled to India in the months that followed. Pakistani forces surrendered only on 16 December.
